scripts.postinstall: rm -rf ios && cap add ios && cd ios/App && agvtool new-marketing-version 1.2.4 && agvtool new-version -all 86
scripts.capacitor:copy:after: npx @capacitor/assets generate --ios && find ios/App -name 'project.pbxproj' -exec sed -i '' 's/PBXFileSystemSynchronizedRootGroup/PBXGroup/g' {} + && /usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Add :NSMicrophoneUsageDescription string 'NIBA needs microphone access to monitor background noise levels for sound activation.'" ios/App/App/Info.plist
